def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # find pattern cells (non-bg, non-zero) and zero block
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    pcells=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j] not in (bg,0)]
    zcells=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==0]
